Held BELOW 7 by three things: ONE POOL AT ONE FEE TIER (the factory shows no 500/3000/10000 tier and no PRIME/wYLDS pool), PRIME Roots CAMPAIGN-SUPPORT, and the fact that this DEX exit is the ONLY route that does not pass through the redeem pipeline.
